name: FFS_CHAT
description: Contains all chats created in Collaboration.

columns.name: STARTED_TIME
columns.description: Timestamp At Which The Chat Started.

columns.name: STARTED_BY
columns.description: Id of the user who started the chat.

columns.name: ENDED_TIME
columns.description: Timestamp At Which The Chat Ended.

columns.name: HELPDESK_ID
columns.description: Id Of The Helpdesk Associated With The Chat.

columns.name: CHAT_TYPE
columns.description: Type Of The Chat. Values Can Be Normal, Conference, Group-Broadcast, Location-Broadcast, Etc.

columns.name: CHAT_MODE
columns.description: Mode of the chat. Values can be collaboration, routing, message_scenario.

columns.name: SUBJECT
columns.description: Display name of the conference chat.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
